details: For every nonempty finite class, the stronger bound $\mathrm{PBTD}(\mathcal H)\leq|\mathcal H|-1$ holds.
proof: Fix any strict preference order. For a target h, choose one disagreement coordinate against each concept preferred to h. The resulting sample rules out every more-preferred consistent concept and has size at most $|\mathcal H|-1$. Thus that order has teaching dimension at most $|\mathcal H|-1$, and minimizing over orders preserves the bound.
name: Size / Preference-Based Teaching Dimension
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
